scope: GPT offline experiment only; no production activation or database writes
data: 177 previously developed historical rows; five minute-cadence recent pairs only for a separate exploratory check
historical_label_availability: production day + 2 days 00:00 Asia/Shanghai; conservative assumption covering ambiguous midnight records, not an observed report timestamp
recent_label_availability: actual sample date + 1 day 00:00 Asia/Shanghai; retrospective simulation only
folds: 51 dates: first 40 development, last 11 historical forward check; inner development 16/8,24/8,32/8 dates; purge training labels unavailable at first validation time
selection: minimum pooled rolling day-balanced MAE within each family; exact ties prefer smaller cap/shorter memory/stronger curve prior
complexity_evidence: K2/K3 must improve rolling day-balanced MAE over K1 by at least 5 percent and improve at least 2 of 3 folds; require forward improvement and supported training components; these are engineering gates, not significance tests
recent_data_use: never fitting or selecting; previously inspected and approximately aligned, not a blind or precise field acceptance test
promotion: none; historical reuse and zero strictly aligned recent samples preclude automatic production switch
